name: Bantam Tools NextDraw 2234
notes: Travel and 80 steps/mm from Bantam Tools' product page. Brushless pen lift: narrow-band servo values from axidraw_conf.py v3.9.0 (nb_servo_*), on port B pin 2. Speeds are this app's 16x-microstepping limit (the vendor's 15 in/s is for 8x mode); acceleration as the AxiDraw. Automatic homing isn't used: put the carriage in the home corner by hand. Untested with this app.
